title: Milestone 2: run the harness on your own data
description: Extend the bias-decisions harness so a user can point it at their own dataset instead of the bundled Bias in Bios sample. Document the input format and add a walkthrough for running an end-to-end evaluation on custom data.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Shape is fixed: tasks/<slug>/items.jsonl plus question.yaml with ordered options; the CLI does not yet ingest an arbitrary corpus.

right_now_summary: The input format is set, but the CLI still cannot ingest a user’s own dataset.
